item.g:description: This 2020 Subaru Legacy Limited is a lot of equipment for the money. The price reflects the 119,072 miles on the odometer rather than the feature list, which is close to fully loaded. It pairs the 2.5 liter four cylinder with the Lineartronic CVT and Subaru all wheel drive, so Chicago winters are a non issue. Inside there is leather seating, heated front seats, dual power seats, a navigation system, harman/kardon audio, SUBARU STARLINK with Bluetooth and SiriusXM, push button start, and a moon roof. Driver assistance is the real strength: EyeSight, adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist, blind spot detection, and a backup camera, backed by knee air bags and full length head curtain air bags. LED headlamps, fog lights, alloy wheels, and the All Weather Package round it out. Finished in silver over a black interior. Value Edition is where Hyundai loaded in the equipment that normally costs extra: a power glass sunroof, heated front seats, a backup camera, keyless entry with keyless start, alloy wheels, and fog lights. On top of that you get air conditioning, cruise control, power windows and power door locks, Bluetooth, SiriusXM satellite radio alongside the AM/FM and CD system, an alarm system, and a tilt and telescoping steering wheel. Safety coverage includes hill start assist control, electronic stability control, traction control, four wheel ABS, and dual, side, and full length head curtain air bags.
